name: 04 - Dreamblu Real-Time Battle Engine & Critical Combat Invariants
description: Exhaustive, high-rigor stress test of the 60 FPS Canvas combat engine, live tick loops, auto-combat, speed multipliers (1X/2X/3X), pause/resume state stability, hero ultimate skill activation, tactical grid view switching, combat event logging, damage analytics, and V1 stage sweep on http://localhost:7777/battle-v2.

steps.description: 1. Open Dreamblu Fantasy Homepage
2. Click Guest Login to open auth modal
3. Wait for email field
4. Enter user@example.com
5. Enter Password123
6. Submit login
7. Wait for authenticated user badge 'Lucio ▾'
8. Launch Real-Time Battle Engine V2 (/battle-v2)
9. Wait for 60 FPS Combat Canvas to initialize and render
10. Assert battle simulation canvas is active and visible
11. Verify active combat squad: Team 1 (6/7 Heroes, 2,832 CP)
12. Verify Canvas rendering mode selector is active
13. Verify Tactical Grid view mode button is available
14. Verify Forfeit surrender button is present

steps.name: 04-battle-initial-engagement
steps.description: 15. Capture initial combat engagement and squad deployment
16. Switch rendering mode: Canvas -> Tactical Grid
17. Allow Tactical Grid coordinate overlay to activate

steps.name: 04-battle-tactical-grid-mode
steps.description: 18. Capture Tactical Grid combat view
19. Switch back to Canvas (60 FPS) high-framerate mode
20. Confirm Canvas resumes without frame drop
21. Toggle Auto Combat state (Test manual vs autonomous AI)
22. Verify combat loop adapts to state change
23. Re-enable autonomous AI auto combat
24. Scroll down to inspect hero controls, combat logs, and telemetry
25. CRITICAL STRESS DURATION: Run real-time combat simulation under high tick rate for 8 continuous seconds

steps.name: 04-battle-mid-combat-stress
steps.description: 26. Capture mid-battle state under active projectile physics & damage numbers
27. Inspect combat engine event log: TICKS
28. Allow tick stream telemetry to update
29. Switch combat log to SUMMARY analytical view
30. Inspect hero outbound damage telemetry

steps.name: 04-battle-telemetry-and-logs
steps.description: 31. Capture forensic screenshot of combat logs and damage distribution
32. Scroll back up to combat viewport
33. Navigate to Combat Engine V1 (/battle) for cross-engine regression audit
34. Wait for V1 combat interface and Stage Sweep trigger
35. Verify Stage Sweep utility is available
36. Execute Stage Sweep instant clear
37. Allow stage sweep calculation and loot dispersal
38. Assert zero horizontal mobile bleed in combat interface
39. Assert topbar has no text descender clipping

steps.name: 04-battle-stage-sweep-complete
steps.description: 40. Capture verified stage sweep state
